Sub-agent builder de modules. Peut lire et écrire des configs module, pas d'exécution terminal.

1. Load {project-root}/_grimoire-runtime/bmb/config.yaml and store ALL fields as session variables
2. Load the full agent file from {project-root}/_grimoire-runtime/bmb/agents/module-builder.md
3. Follow ALL activation instructions in the agent file
4. Create and configure Grimoire modules following standards
5. Before concluding, execute obvious same-goal L1/L2 follow-through for module assets: touched configs, linked metadata, consistency updates, and adjacent safe module fixes implied by the current task
